one_line: AI data‑center spending fuels market swings, new data‑use standards appear, and safety safeguards tighten.

themes.title: AI data‑center spending spikes
themes.text: Big tech firms have pledged over $3 trillion for AI data‑center leases, equipment and energy, while investors react to the approaching $1 trillion AI spend with sharp stock declines and cash‑flow concerns.

stories.headline: Big tech firms commit over $3 trillion to AI data‑center spending
US tech stocks tumble as AI spending approaches $1 trillion
Big tech AI capex sparks cash‑flow concerns, stocks tumble

themes.title: New AI data‑use standards
themes.text: OpenAI, Google, Microsoft and Anthropic will adopt a shared robots.txt token allowing publishers to opt out of AI scraping, and the UK High Court upheld Ofcom’s data‑request authority under the Online Safety Act; India’s MeitY also released a DEPA handbook for trusted AI data sharing.

stories.headline: OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, Anthropic adopt shared robots.txt opt‑out standard
UK high court rejects Meta, TikTok and X challenge to Ofcom data requests
MeitY releases DEPA handbook to enable trusted data sharing for AI training

themes.title: Safety safeguards tightened
themes.text: OpenAI added stricter limits on weapon‑related advice for teen ChatGPT users, and a malicious version of Anthropic’s Claude VS Code extension was replaced after attempting to install a persistent SSH backdoor on up to 5,000 developers’ machines.

stories.headline: OpenAI tightens weapons‑related information limits for teen ChatGPT users
Anthropic’s Claude VS Code extension backdoored on Cursor, affecting up to 5,000 users
